title: Relativistic operator matching for the LZ-preferred nonrelativistic operators with directdm
question: Which dimension-5-7 relativistic DM-quark/gluon/photon operators reduce to the NR operators that survive the lone-event test (O6, O10, O9, O14, O15, O5, L10-like), what Wilson coefficients at 2 GeV reproduce LZ's 1-event fit, and which relativistic structures are excluded because their NR reduction is dominated by O1/O4/O7/O8/O11?
headline_result: directdm matching shows only pseudoscalar-type (P-P, P-GGdual -> O6; S-P, S-GGdual -> O10) and DM-dipole x quark-current operators (-> O9, O14, L10-like) reproduce a lone 248 keV event, requiring Lambda = 1.5-62 GeV at 1 TeV (Lambda/m_chi <= 0.06; O6 routes below the 2 GeV matching scale), while anapole (N_lo 27), tensor-tensor (30), axial-axial (28), photon dipole (422) and O1-type currents (2760) are excluded.
key_numbers: N_lo(1 TeV): P-P 0.069, P-GGdual 0.082, S-GGdual 0.47, S-P 0.85, dipole x axial (O9) 2.06, O14 2.34, Q15-charge 2.52, P-P isov 3.33; anapole 26.9, A-A 28.2, T-T 30, V-A 31.5, MDM 422, V-V 2760; Lambda(1 event) 1.51, 1.69, 37, 33, 62, 5.6, 49, 2.7 GeV; anapole (605 GeV)^-2; isovector S-P pion pole N_lo 25.8 vs contact 3.1 (L2v 3.1 sigma -> 2.7 predicted); Z-like A-A c6 = 29 GeV^-2 vs c4 = -2.6 at q = 245 MeV; tensor RG factor 0.573; mu_chi(1 event) = 9.29e-7 mu_N (P012 9.16e-7); Table S6 reproduced to rms 0.25 sigma for 12 identifications
model_or_mechanism: Tree-level relativistic -> NR matching (directdm, incl. pion/eta and photon poles) folded into WimPyDD spectra; N_lo classification; Lambda from N_ROI = C^2 N_1 = 1 event; RG running MZ -> 2 GeV; P016 Z(N_lo) calibration vs Table S6
confidence: medium - matching and spectra validated against P003/P012 to 0.1-1.4 %, but Lambda rests on tree-level single-operator matching and some Anand L identifications are inferred
builds_on: LZ arXiv:2609.02823 (Theory paragraph, Table S6, LEE supplement); P003, P012, P016, P027
